I went through all three, marking MDN done and then chasing it to its new spot.

Version 1 matches what I want best. The two tabs up top — **To read** and **Done**, each with its count — feel exactly like the "two distinct places" I described. When I marked MDN done, it vanished from To read, the counts flipped to To read 1 / Done 2, and I clicked over to the Done tab and there it was. Switching between the two piles with a tab feels clean and I always know which pile I'm looking at.

Version 2 (the same idea but tabs down the side) worked the same way — I just liked it slightly less than having them across the top, but it's the same concept. Version 3, the two side-by-side columns, is kind of satisfying because you watch the card jump across — but I think once I've got a lot of links, two columns crammed next to each other would feel tight and I'd rather give one list the full width.

So Version 1, please.

And yes, both of those behaviors feel right:

- Moving it immediately when I change the status is what I'd expect — I don't want to hit a separate "apply" or see it linger in the wrong pile.
- Each pile showing its current count is genuinely useful — that "To read" number is basically my backlog staring at me, which is the whole point of keeping them separate.

This separation is good.
